name: schedule_edit
description: Update, pause, resume or delete one scheduled task. Use the revision from schedule_view/list; deleting is permanent. Changing timing recomputes the next occurrence.

action.description: update changes fields; delete removes the task permanently.

expected_revision.description: Revision read from schedule_view/list. If the schedule changed since then, the edit is rejected instead of overwriting.

active.description: false pauses; true resumes. Reactivating an ended task needs a new timing.

timing.description: New timing; same shape and rules as schedule_create.

prompt: Host-level scheduled tasks: create, list, view, and edit a persisted rule that delivers a synthetic user follow-up at its due time. `{{tools}}` manage the rule only; the delivered turn does the work. A schedule is not a Job: use `job_*`/`workflow` when you need immediate asynchronous execution, output and cancellation.
